about: Owner instructions the fund carries out at its next trading cycle while the venue is open (scripts/fund_cycle.py, fund_orchestrator.plan owner_trims). A trim sells part of a held position so its worst case (fund_risk) is at most max_worst_case_share of the fund; it repeats only if the position grows 10% past that again. A hold keeps a held pair open: the pair rules (relative value, holding limits) do not close it while it is listed; remove the entry to hand it back to the rules.

trims.reason: Owner: bring the Nifty Bank put credit spread inside the 3% risk limit (it could lose 4.6% of the fund).

holds.reason: Owner: keep the copper / aluminium pair (long copper, short aluminium, opened 2026-11-16) open; the owner expects the ratio to swing back.
